url: Local filesystem and git history of /home/user/GLP-Fund (no network involved)

extracted.FINDING: Every one of the seven paths listed in the prior gate's fixtures_written array is MISSING at the stated location. The directory /home/user/GLP-Fund/fixtures/ did not exist at all when I checked (ls: cannot access 'fixtures/': No such file or directory).
extracted.ACTUAL_LOCATION_FOUND: All seven files DO exist, with the same basenames, under /home/user/GLP-Fund/test/fixtures/. The content is intact and parses as valid JSON. So the data was not lost - the reported paths are simply wrong.
extracted.MISDIAGNOSIS_IN_PRIOR_NARRATIVE: The prior narrative claims 'fixtures I wrote at 10:24Z were destroyed mid-task by a concurrent process ... commit a3cf13e emptied fixtures/ of everything'. Git disagrees. a3cf13e shows the gate-lilly and gate-orf and gate-bridge fixture files as RENAMES into test/fixtures/ with zero line changes (git --stat renders them as '.../gate-lilly-mounjaro-located-unconfirmed.json | 15 +' and '{fixtures => test/fixtures}' pure moves). The files were MOVED by a refactor, not destroyed by a hostile concurrent writer. The prior report's further claim that it 'rewrote my seven files and verified them present' at fixtures/ is not borne out - they are not there.
extracted.current_worktree_state: git status shows the entire fixtures/ tree as deleted (D) relative to HEAD, including cross-rules-* and gate-bridge-verify-* and gate-orf-verify-* files committed in 57bf898. A later reorganization, not a race, is the parsimonious explanation.
extracted.CONSEQUENCE: An orchestrator or reviewer following the prior gate's fixtures_written array would find nothing at any listed path and could conclude the evidence freeze never happened. The verification trail is broken as published, which is a process defect independent of the price findings.
